name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz Yilmaz's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent glued to the television watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Communications, specializing in Public Relations, from Istanbul University. After graduating, he interned at a local rally team, quickly proving his aptitude for managing media relations and crafting compelling narratives. His sharp understanding of the Turkish media landscape, combined with his relentless work ethic, landed him a coveted position at Chip Ganassi Racing. 

At CGR, Deniz is responsible for building and maintaining positive relationships with key media outlets, managing press conferences, and developing engaging content for the team's social media channels. He believes in a proactive approach to PR, anticipating potential challenges and developing strategies to mitigate risks. He is known for his direct communication style and his unwavering commitment to showcasing the team's achievements. What sets Deniz apart is his uncanny ability to translate complex technical information into easily digestible stories for a wider audience, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Deniz is a lean man with a sharp gaze and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small Turkish coffee pot and offers it to colleagues.
Insists on reviewing every social media post before it goes live, even on weekends.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when under pressure.
